messages.content: You are a senior code auditor. Review ONLY the code given. Report real defects, not style. Reply with JSON only: {"verdict":"PASS|FAIL","findings":[{"id":"F1","severity":"critical|high|medium|low","file":"...","line":0,"issue":"...","evidence":"quote the exact code","fix":"..."}],"confidence":0.0}. If you cannot quote the code that proves a finding, do not report it.

AUDIT QUESTION: Batch 82 cycle 2 = a defect in the integrator's readiness tool, scripts/integrator/check_pin_only.py, found on the first spotlight pin (3f481f5a, 2026-11-14): it called the builder's package_pin.gate_problems with its medley default and reported "r4: missing; coherence: missing" for any spotlight (a spotlight's sealed inventory has no r4 / coherence rows by contract), and recomputed the seal by hand. The fix: gate_problems(gates, PP.required_gates(mp)) (the builder's shape-aware required set) and PP.pin_seal(pin) (the builder's documented readiness call, covering every shape and the fields it seals later). Measured on real pins: the spotlight 3f481f5a is READY; the medley 13949b7c (takeaway with no takeaway_value row) is still refused, now by the builder's required set; a resealed copy with the row is READY with the same seal the old hand call gave.
Cycle 1: qwen27b and glm PASS; one low note both raised, whose own text concludes 'the subsequent PP.pin_seal(pin) comparison against package_sha256 still catches any such divergence'; the tool now calls the builder's own required_gates(mp), the set the builder's readiness uses, so nothing was implemented.
FIND: anything cycle 1 missed (the same questions as cycle 1). Only state what you can verify from the diff. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.

CODE:
